We loved staying there, it’s clean and cozy. There is a laundry room on the ground floor, with free detergent . Loved the location, in the mornings there is a market right outside with all the food you can imagine.
Although could be hard to walk with all the luggage if you arrive/leave from 7am to 2pm

The room looked exactly like the photos in the listing. Everything was very clean, and the bed and pillows were super comfortable. I also appreciated the free little snacks provided. The staff were incredibly helpful, and the host was quick to respond to any questions. Overall, a great stay!

Had the pleasure of staying at Unit 7A, the top floor of the building - a quiet, convenient spot right in the heart of Silom. The location is perfect... just steps from Chong Nonsi BTS, and walkable to Sala Daeng BTS, Silom MRT, and also Dusit Central Park mall.

The view was fantastic, surrounded by iconic tall buildings yet not blocked by them. You still get a sense of openness, especially at sunrise and sunset. There’s no noise from clubs or bars at night, though you might still hear faint sounds of BTS trains in the distance.

On weekdays, the Lalai Sap morning market comes alive right downstairs, full of friendly locals and affordable Thai food. It’s a lovely glimpse of everyday Bangkok life right at your doorstep.

Laundry was easy too... there’s a washer on the ground floor and a rooftop area for drying clothes, which made longer stays really convenient.

Overall, a great stay for anyone who wants easy city access without the chaos. Highly recommended.

Convenient to BTS, a pearl right in the middle of Thai local life. Clean and comfy. Everything you need is in the apartment and local restaurants, international restaurants right outside. And a great local live music place.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Cozy Sunday, and I highly recommend it! The place is absolutely amazing—clean, new, and beautifully maintained. The location is perfect, just a stone's throw away from everything you might need,food and BTS making it incredibly convenient for exploring the area.

A huge thank you to the hosts for their exceptional hospitality and for creating such a welcoming environment. I had a fantastic experience and would love to come back in the future!

We stayed in 2 rooms 3A and 6A for 5 days for 4 people. Both rooms are brand new, fully furnished with large windows for natural light and a great view of Mahanakhon and Empire Tower. But I wish there were more white lights. The host and co-host are always available for online support via text message. The housekeeping staff is also very friendly, she helped us carry our suitcases when checking in and out. They also provide laundry service on the 1st floor and drying clothes on the rooftop (there is an elevator so no need to worry about moving). Cozy Sunday Silom Soi 7 is located right in the heart of Silom, close to BTS Chong Nonsi, 7-Eleven, Park Silom and has a market right below (but not noisy in the morning). This is a great place, worth the price and fits all the requirements for our Bangkok trip.

I was initially skeptical about booking this apartment since it had no reviews, but I quickly realized that I was the very first guest to stay here—and what a pleasant surprise! The apartment is absolutely fantastic. Everything is brand new, spacious, and designed with top-tier modern decor. It really feels like a luxury home in the heart of Bangkok.

The location couldn’t be better—central, close to everything, yet tucked away just enough to offer peace and quiet after a day in the bustling city. Whether you’re here for work or leisure, you’ll find it convenient to access key areas like shopping, dining, and transportation.

The professionalism of the host was another highlight of my stay. Communication was seamless, and they were incredibly responsive and accommodating throughout my booking and stay. It’s clear they take great pride in providing a top-notch experience.

If you’re considering a place in Bangkok, don’t hesitate to book this apartment. It’s a hidden gem, and I’m sure it won’t remain undiscovered for long!
